findings.highlight: past this one small sheet, is Saber’s room
findings.evidenceJa: 襖一枚隔てた向こうがセイバーの部屋
findings.governingReading: Saber’s room lies next door beyond a single fusuma panel.
findings.explanation: Small sheet fails to identify the sliding partition and makes the room layout sound physically absurd.

findings.highlight: I am still above my average.
findings.evidenceJa: このままでも平均値はクリアしています
findings.governingReading: Even unhealed, Saber clears the general average standard for a Servant.
findings.explanation: My average changes a comparative class benchmark into Saber’s personal historical average.

findings.highlight: I have to have her do something she enjoys.
findings.evidenceJa: ちゃんと自分の楽しみを持たないと嘘だと思う
findings.governingReading: Shirou thinks Saber ought to have joys of her own while she exists here.
findings.explanation: The English makes Shirou the agent who must make her perform an enjoyable activity, undercutting the autonomy he wants for her.

findings.highlight: I shouldn’t have been interested in Saber’s true identity
findings.evidenceJa: 俺はセイバーの正体になんて興味はなかった筈だし
findings.governingReading: Shirou thought he was not interested in Saber’s identity, but now recognizes that has changed.
findings.explanation: Shouldn’t have been makes the interest improper rather than contradicting his prior self-image.

findings.highlight: I feel that I must ask you to understand.
findings.evidenceJa: 貴方という人間を知る為に訊いておくべき事
findings.governingReading: Saber must ask in order to understand Shirou as a person.
findings.explanation: The translation omits the object and purpose of understanding, weakening the scene’s explicit relational aim.

findings.highlight: I deflect it with heartless words.
findings.evidenceJa: 心にもない言葉で、懸命にはね除けた
findings.governingReading: Shirou desperately fends off her warning with words he does not mean.
findings.explanation: Heartless falsely characterizes the content as cruel instead of marking the promise as insincere.

findings.highlight: If you do not make any mistakes, you will become a proper magus.
findings.evidenceJa: 道さえ間違えなければ、きっと正しい魔術師になれる
findings.governingReading: If Shirou does not take the wrong path, Saber believes he can become a proper magus.
findings.explanation: Any mistakes turns an ethical warning about direction into a demand for general errorlessness.

findings.highlight: Such wisdom is sometimes called as cowardice.
findings.evidenceJa: そういった賢明さを、時に臆病と言うのです
findings.governingReading: That kind of prudence is sometimes called cowardice.
findings.explanation: Called as is grammatically incorrect in this construction.

findings.highlight: we end up staying in the room together a while
findings.evidenceJa: 味気ない部屋で時間を過ごす事になった
findings.governingReading: They pass some time together in the bare, flavorless room after he loses his words.
findings.explanation: The room’s emotional and physical barrenness disappears from the closing image.
